rawSql.name: economy.insertAccount
rawSql.sql:
INSERT INTO "EconomyAccount" ("id","guildId","userId","balance","dailyStreak","importedGlobal","createdAt","updatedAt")
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::bigint::int, 0, ?, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
    ON CONFLICT ("guildId","userId") DO NOTHING

rawSql.name: economy.credit
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "EconomyAccount"
    SET "balance" = GREATEST("balance"::bigint, LEAST("balance"::bigint + ?::bigint, ?::bigint))::int,
        "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ?
    RETURNING "balance"

rawSql.name: economy.debit
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "EconomyAccount"
    SET "balance" = ("balance"::bigint - ?::bigint)::int, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ? AND "balance" >= ?::bigint
    RETURNING "balance"

rawSql.name: economy.lockAccounts
rawSql.sql:
SELECT "id" FROM "EconomyAccount"
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" IN (?, ?)
    ORDER BY "userId" FOR UPDATE

rawSql.name: economy.creditChecked
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "EconomyAccount"
    SET "balance" = ("balance"::bigint + ?::bigint)::int, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ?
      AND "balance"::bigint + ?::bigint <= ?::bigint
    RETURNING "balance"

rawSql.name: economy.removeCoins
rawSql.sql:
WITH old AS (
      SELECT "id", "balance" FROM "EconomyAccount"
      WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ? FOR UPDATE
    )
    UPDATE "EconomyAccount" a
    SET "balance" = GREATEST(old."balance"::bigint - ?::bigint, 0)::int, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    FROM old WHERE a."id" = old."id"
    RETURNING a."balance" AS "balance", old."balance" AS "before"

rawSql.name: economy.claimDaily
rawSql.sql:
WITH cur AS (
      SELECT "id",
             CASE WHEN "lastDaily" IS NULL OR "lastDaily" < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '48 hours'
                  THEN 1 ELSE LEAST("dailyStreak", 999999) + 1 END AS ns
      FROM "EconomyAccount"
      WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ?
        AND ("lastDaily" IS NULL OR "lastDaily" <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '24 hours')
      FOR UPDATE
    )
    UPDATE "EconomyAccount" a SET
      "dailyStreak" = cur.ns,
      "balance" = GREATEST(a."balance"::bigint, LEAST(
          a."balance"::bigint
          + (((?::bigint * (CASE LEAST(cur.ns, 7) WHEN 1 THEN 10 WHEN 2 THEN 11 WHEN 3 THEN 12
                                       WHEN 4 THEN 14 WHEN 5 THEN 18 WHEN 6 THEN 25 ELSE 40 END) + 5) / 10)
             * (100 + ?::bigint)) / 100,
          ?::bigint))::int,
      "lastDaily" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
      "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    FROM cur
    WHERE a."id" = cur."id"
    RETURNING a."balance" AS "balance", a."dailyStreak" AS "dailyStreak", a."lastDaily" AS "lastDaily"

rawSql.name: economy.claimWork
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "EconomyAccount"
    SET "balance" = GREATEST("balance"::bigint, LEAST("balance"::bigint + ?::bigint, ?::bigint))::int,
        "lastWork" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ?
      AND ("lastWork" IS NULL OR "lastWork" <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - make_interval(mins => ?::int))
    RETURNING "balance", "lastWork"

rawSql.name: economy.claimPity
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "EconomyAccount"
    SET "balance" = GREATEST("balance"::bigint, LEAST("balance"::bigint + ?::bigint, ?::bigint))::int,
        "lastPity" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "guildId" = ? AND "userId" = ?
      AND "balance" < ?::int
      AND ("lastPity" IS NULL OR "lastPity" <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - interval '12 hours')
    RETURNING "balance"

rawSql.name: economy.insertBoostUse
rawSql.sql:
INSERT INTO "EconomyBoostUse" ("id","boostId","userId","periodKey","createdAt")
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
    ON CONFLICT ("boostId","userId","periodKey") DO NOTHING
    RETURNING "id"

rawSql.name: economy.reserveStock
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "ShopItem"
    SET "stock" = CASE WHEN "stock" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE "stock" - ?::int END, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "id" = ? AND "guildId" = ? AND "enabled" = true AND ("stock" IS NULL OR "stock" >= ?::int)
    RETURNING *

rawSql.name: economy.addInventoryCapped
rawSql.sql:
INSERT INTO "InventoryItem" ("id","guildId","userId","itemId","quantity","createdAt","updatedAt")
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::int, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
    ON CONFLICT ("itemId","userId") DO UPDATE
    SET "quantity" = "InventoryItem"."quantity" + EXCLUDED."quantity", "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "InventoryItem"."quantity" + EXCLUDED."quantity" <= ?::int
    RETURNING "quantity"

rawSql.name: economy.addInventory
rawSql.sql:
INSERT INTO "InventoryItem" ("id","guildId","userId","itemId","quantity","createdAt","updatedAt")
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::int, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
    ON CONFLICT ("itemId","userId") DO UPDATE
    SET "quantity" = "InventoryItem"."quantity" + EXCLUDED."quantity", "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    RETURNING "quantity"

rawSql.name: economy.restoreStock
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "ShopItem" SET "stock" = "stock" + ?::int, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "id" = ? AND "guildId" = ? AND "stock" IS NOT NULL

rawSql.name: economy.reduceInventory
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "InventoryItem"
    SET "quantity" = GREATEST("quantity" - ?::int, 0), "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "itemId" = ? AND "userId" = ? AND "guildId" = ?

rawSql.name: economy.deleteEmptyInventory
rawSql.sql:
DELETE FROM "InventoryItem"
    WHERE "itemId" = ? AND "userId" = ? AND "guildId" = ? AND "quantity" <= 0

rawSql.name: economy.consumeItem
rawSql.sql:
UPDATE "InventoryItem"
    SET "quantity" = "quantity" - 1, "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    WHERE "itemId" = ? AND "userId" = ? AND "guildId" = ? AND "quantity" >= 1
    RETURNING "quantity"

rawSql.name: economy.takeItem
rawSql.sql:
WITH old AS (
      SELECT "id", "quantity" FROM "InventoryItem"
      WHERE "itemId" = ? AND "userId" = ? AND "guildId" = ? FOR UPDATE
    )
    UPDATE "InventoryItem" i
    SET "quantity" = GREATEST(old."quantity" - ?::int, 0), "updatedAt" = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
    FROM old WHERE i."id" = old."id"
    RETURNING i."quantity" AS "remaining", old."quantity" AS "before"
